title: ZinggumDol: a gentle journal for the days that go wrong
description: Miss a goal and a little pebble speaks first: it asks what happened, then how you feel, one at a time. No sign-up, no ads. Three goals are free.

problem.title: When a day doesn't go to plan, do you blame yourself?
problem.text: On a night you skipped the workout, the first thought is usually "what's wrong with me?" Look closer and there was a late shift, it was raining, you were worn out. ZinggumDol asks about what happened and how you feel in separate turns, then lays the two side by side. Once you see it was the circumstances and not your willpower, the next small step gets easier to find.

features.title: The pebble speaks first
features.text:
Set a goal and the pebble keeps track of the days you made it and the days you got stuck. When a day slips by, it asks "what happened?" instead of "why didn't you?", and it remembers what you told it last time so it can ask how things went since.
On days when writing feels like too much, just say it. Speech is recognized on your device and recordings are never saved.

features.title: Your days laid out as stepping stones
features.text:
Each week is a row of stepping stones. The days you missed stay there too; nothing gets wiped away.
Even with a gap or two, you can see the path still carries on.

features.title: Come back to what you wrote
features.text:
What happened, how you felt and what you'll try next pile up in date order. Look back at a day you got stuck in the same way and you'll see what worked.
A Home Screen widget shows a word from the pebble, and a reminder at a time you pick nudges you to look back on the day.

items.title: Open the app at the end of the day
items.text: The pebble asks how today went. Set a reminder so you don't forget.

items.title: Tap or type a reply
items.text: You can stop any time with `I'd rather leave it for now`.

pricing.note: No payment screen ever pops up in the middle of a conversation. On a new device or after reinstalling, tap Restore Purchase in Settings.

items.q: Do I have to explain every missed day?
items.a: No. Tap `I'd rather leave it for now` at any point and the conversation ends right there. What you've said so far is kept, so you can pick it up later.

items.q: I actually did it, but the app says I didn't.
items.a: Tap `I did it, just didn't log it`. The pebble takes the correction and asks what helped instead. What worked gets saved, and it brings it back the next time you get stuck.

items.q: Where does what I say out loud go?
items.a: Your speech is turned into text on your device and the recording is never saved. On supported devices your words are tidied up so they read more easily, and that happens on the device too.

items.q: How many goals can I have?
items.a: Three for free. When you're done with one, use `Set Down` in The way you've come to free up a spot. For more than three, you'll need ZinggumDol Pro.
No. You pay once and keep it. On a new device or after reinstalling, tap `Restore Purchase` in Settings.

items.q: Can anyone else read my journal?
items.a: There's no account. Your records live only on your device and in your own iCloud, and you can lock the app with a passcode in Settings. What you write is never sent to the developer. You can also turn off anonymous usage statistics in Settings.

items.q: How do I change the reminder time?
items.a: Go to `Daily reminders` in Settings to turn them on or off and pick a time.

items.q: Does the pebble ever bring up my old wins?
items.a: Yes. When you mention something that worked before, the pebble remembers it, and on a hard day it reminds you of something you managed recently.

Tap `Delete All Records` in Settings. Your goals and records are gone for good, including on other devices synced through iCloud. Your settings and purchases stay. With Pro, you can save a copy with `Export records` first.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Use Send Feedback in the app's Settings, or email the address below.
